checks.name: All primary pages under Dark / Neo Green / Light
UI watchdog stayed quiet during stress
Incremental counters
checks.detail: 5,000 move actions counted without full-list rescans

root_cause_findings: UI log draining could remain in an unbounded loop while producers kept adding events, starving Tk callbacks.
Recording statistics copied and rescanned the full action list repeatedly.
Recovery journal work was performed per action instead of in batches.
Monitor metadata was repeatedly queried during recording in the downloadable source build.
limitations: Physical mouse/keyboard hooks, real Windows UI Automation, and final Windows desktop responsiveness still require live testing on the target Windows PC.
